description: Inspect operational logs and endpoint telemetry; fix confirmed slow/failing endpoints and improve request/response contracts with focused validation.

acceptance_criteria: Recent endpoint failures and latency hotspots are classified from retained telemetry and trace evidence.
Confirmed server or response-contract defects are fixed at their source with focused regression coverage.
Repetition detection releases the GPU fence only after the backend confirms completion; incomplete or timed-out streams remain fenced.
Focused checks pass and diff check is clean.
Live process has loaded the current source and representative endpoint/trace behavior is verified after separately authorized restart.
Opening #traceInspector directly loads retained trace summaries; request-history rows match by request_id; enabled HTTP model traces persist output and retain API response separately.
task_endpoint_reliability_audit.blocker: Full pytest and a later fail-fast run reported failures and are not final candidate evidence. FIM quality, detailed diagnostics, release-check nested DB, and affected_tests empty-path contract remain open.
task_endpoint_reliability_audit.description: Audit operational logs and endpoint latency/failures; repair response contracts and recurring GPU reservation after repetition while preserving fail-closed behavior; include Trace Inspector direct-link history loading, request-to-trace matching, and enabled HTTP model-output capture.
task_endpoint_reliability_audit.next_action: Fix Trace Inspector history loading and HTTP DebugTraceObserver wiring; add focused regression coverage. Then continue existing endpoint audit.
